title: Non-rectifiable Delone sets under pointwise co-Lipschitz bijections
summary: For each $d\in\N_{\geq 2}$ we construct a Delone set $Y$ in $\R^{d}$ for which every Lipschitz bijection from $Y$ to $\Z^{d}$ has a very irregular inverse. For example, the inverse fails to be Lipschitz, even at just a single point. Further, we clarify the relationship between several notions of regularity for bijections between Delone sets, studied in the literature.
